description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.
